caption: The drawing depicts a single vase placed on a horizontal dark green surface. The vase is hourglass-shaped, with a wider top and bottom and a narrower middle section. The surface of the vase features a combination of reddish-brown and dark brown hues, with some areas showing hints of yellowish or olive green coloring. The background is a neutral beige with no visible details other than the colored surface the vase rests upon. Above the vase, the words "DECORATED VASE CIRCA 1850" are written in large, evenly spaced, blue-gray capital letters. The lighting and shading on the vase suggest a light source coming from the left, highlighting the contours and texture of the vase's surface.
title: Vase
